content.comment_body: Technical question imported from a user who is not registered.

Hello, To address this, start by designing a circuit that ensures only one of five status signals is set to '1' at a time, using a combination of AND/OR logic blocks. Add five asynchronous pulse generators, assigning each its own signal pattern and timing settings. Connect each status line to the 'enable' input of its respective pulse generator. Combine the outputs of all pulse generators using an OR block, and attach this to an indicator light.
